name: writing-from-notes
title_zh: 从旧笔记里长出新文章的起笔器
tagline_zh: 别对着空白页发愁。它翻出你读过的书、写过的批注，把散落的旧想法拼成第一段——你只需决定往哪走。
tagline_en: Blank page? It digs through your past reading and margin notes, stitching scattered thoughts into a first.
desc_en: Use when starting a substantive piece of writing — essay, summary, post, design doc, blog draft — where the topic has been encountered in past reading or work.
why_zh: 不是模板填空，是带着你重访旧材料，让论点从你已有的理解里长出来，而不是从零硬憋。
why_en: No template-filling. It walks you back through old material so your argument grows from what you already know—not from thin air.
limit_zh: 只认你喂过的笔记（Markdown/文本），不接 PDF 或网页抓取；产出是草稿骨架，不负责润色成稿，也不查文献出处。
limit_en: Only works with notes you feed it (Markdown/text), not PDFs or web scraping. Output is a draft skeleton—no polishing, no citation checking.
title_en: Start writing from notes you already have
